text.2:39: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.
text.2:87: And verily We gave unto Moses the Scripture and We caused a train of messengers to follow after him, and We gave unto Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), and We supported him with the Holy spirit. Is it ever so, that, when there cometh unto you a messenger (from Allah) with that which ye yourselves desire not, ye grow arrogant, and some ye disbelieve and some ye slay?
text.3:11: Like Pharaoh's folk and those who were before them, they disbelieved Our revelations and so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment.
text.3:184: And if they deny thee, even so did they deny messengers who were before thee, who came with miracles and with the Psalms and with the Scripture giving light.
text.5:10: And they who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are rightful owners of hell.
text.5:70: We made a covenant of old with the Children of Israel and We sent unto them messengers. As often as a messenger came unto them with that which their souls desired not (they became rebellious). Some (of them) they denied and some they slew.
text.5:86: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
text.6:5: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride.
text.6:21: Who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah or denieth His revelations? Lo! the wrongdoers will not be successful.
text.6:27: If thou couldst see when they are set before the Fire and say: Oh, would that we might return! Then would we not deny the revelations of our Lord but we would be of the believers!
text.6:31: They indeed are losers who deny their meeting with Allah until, when the Hour cometh on them suddenly, they cry: Alas for us, that we neglected it! They bear upon their backs their burdens. Ah, evil is that which they bear!
text.6:33: We know well how their talk grieveth thee, though in truth they deny not thee (Muhammad) but evil-doers flout the revelations of Allah.
text.6:34: Messengers indeed have been denied before thee, and they were patient under the denial and the persecution till Our succour reached them. There is none to alter the decisions of Allah. Already there hath reached thee (somewhat) of the tidings of the messengers (We sent before).
text.6:39: Those who deny Our revelations are deaf and dumb in darkness. Whom Allah will sendeth astray, and whom He will He placeth on a straight path.
text.6:49: But as for those who deny Our revelations, torment will afflict them for that they used to disobey.
text.6:57: Say: I am (relying) on clear proof from my Lord, while ye deny Him. I have not that for which ye are impatient. The decision is for Allah only. He telleth the truth and He is the Best of Deciders.
text.6:66: Thy people (O Muhammad) have denied it, though it is the Truth. Say: I am not put in charge of you.
text.6:147: So if they give the lie to thee (Muhammad), say: Your Lord is a Lord of All-Embracing Mercy, and His wrath will never be withdrawn from guilty folk.
text.6:148: They who are idolaters will say: Had Allah willed, we had not ascribed (unto Him) partners neither had our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught. Thus did those who were before them give the lie (to Allah's messengers) till they tasted of the fear of Us. Say: Have ye any knowledge that ye can adduce for Us? Lo! ye follow naught but an opinion, Lo! ye do but guess.
text.6:150: Say: Come, bring your witnesses who can bear witness that Allah forbade (all) this. And if they bear witness, do not thou bear witness with them. Follow thou not the whims of those who deny Our revelations, those who believe not in the Hereafter and deem (others) equal with their Lord.
text.6:157: Or lest ye should say: If the Scripture had been revealed unto us, we surely had been better guided than are they. Now hath there come unto you a clear proof from your Lord, a guidance and mercy; and who doeth greater wrong than he who denieth the revelations of Allah, and turneth away from them? We award unto those who turn away from Our revelations an evil doom because of their aversion.
text.7:36: But they who deny Our revelations and scorn them - each are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.
text.7:37: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah or denieth Our tokens. (For such) their appointed portion of the Book (of destiny) reacheth them till, when Our messengers come to gather them, they say: Where (now) is that to which ye cried beside Allah? They say: They have departed from us. And they testify against themselves that they were disbelievers.
text.7:40: Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.
text.7:64: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who denied Our tokens. Lo! they were blind folk.
text.7:72: And We saved him and those with him by a mercy from Us, and We cut the root of those who denied Our revelations and were not believers.
text.7:92: Those who denied Shu'eyb became as though they had not dwelt there. Those who denied Shu'eyb, they were the losers.
text.7:96: And if the people of the townships had believed and kept from evil, surely We should have opened for them blessings from the sky and from the earth. But (unto every messenger) they gave the lie, and so We seized them on account of what they used to earn.
text.7:101: Such were the townships. We relate some tidings of them unto thee (Muhammad). Their messengers verily came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they could not believe because they had before denied. Thus doth Allah print upon the hearts of disbelievers (that they hear not).
text.7:136: Therefore We took retribution from them; therefore We drowned them in the sea: because they denied Our revelations and were heedless of them.
text.7:146: I shall turn away from My revelations those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth, and if they see each token believe it not, and if they see the way of righteousness choose it nor for (their) way, and if they see the way of error choose if for (their) way. That is because they deny Our revelations and are used to disregard them.
text.7:147: Those who deny Our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are fruitless. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?
text.7:176: And had We willed We could have raised him by their means, but he clung to the earth and followed his own lust. Therefor his likeness is as the likeness of a dog: if thou attackest him he panteth with his tongue out, and if thou leavest him he panteth with his tongue out. Such is the likeness of the people who deny Our revelations. Narrate unto them the history (of the men of old), that haply they may take thought.
text.7:177: Evil as an example are the folk who denied Our revelations, and were wont to wrong themselves.
text.7:182: And those who deny Our revelations - step by step We lead them on from whence they know not.
text.8:54: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they denied the revelations of their Lord, so We destroyed them in their sins. And We drowned the folk of Pharaoh. All were evil-doers.
text.10:17: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah and denieth His revelations? Lo! the guilty never are successful.
text.10:39: Nay, but they denied that, the knowledge whereof they could not compass, and whereof the interpretation (in events) hath not yet come unto them. Even so did those before them deny. Then see what was the consequence for the wrong-doers!
text.10:41: And if they deny thee, say: Unto me my work, and unto you your work. Ye are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what ye do.
text.10:45: And on the day when He shall gather them together, (when it will seem) as though they had tarried but an hour of the day, recognising one another, those will verily have perished who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided.
text.10:73: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made them viceroys (in the earth), while We drowned those who denied Our revelations. See then the nature of the consequence for those who had been warned.
text.10:74: Then, after him, We sent messengers unto their folk, and they brought them clear proofs. But they were not ready to believe in that which they before denied. Thus print We on the hearts of the transgressors.
text.10:95: And be not thou of those who deny the revelations of Allah, for then wert thou of the losers.
text.15:80: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
text.16:113: And verily there had come unto them a messenger from among them, but they had denied him, and so the torment seized them while they were wrong-doers.
text.17:59: Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent save to warn.
text.20:48: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.
text.20:56: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.
text.21:77: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
text.22:42: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers);
text.22:44: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence!
text.22:57: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom.
text.23:26: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text.23:33: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
text.23:39: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text.23:44: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
text.23:48: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
text.23:105: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
text.25:11: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.
text.25:19: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.
text.25:36: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
text.25:37: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
text.25:77: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
text.26:6: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
text.26:12: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
text.26:105: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.26:117: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
text.26:123: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
text.26:139: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
text.26:141: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
text.26:160: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.26:176: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.26:189: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
text.27:83: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;
text.27:84: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?
text.28:34: My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.
text.29:18: But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.
text.29:37: But they denied him, and the dreadful earthquake took them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling place.
text.29:68: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah, or denieth the truth when it cometh unto him? Is not there a home in hell for disbelievers?
text.30:10: Then evil was the consequence to those who dealt in evil, because they denied the revelations of Allah and made a mock of them.
text.30:16: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, such will be brought to doom.
text.32:20: And as for those who do evil, their retreat is the Fire. Whenever they desire to issue forth from thence, they are brought back thither. Unto them it is said: Taste the torment of the Fire which ye used to deny.
text.34:42: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.
text.34:45: Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)!
text.35:4: And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee. Unto Allah all things are brought back.
text.35:25: And if they deny thee, those before them also denied. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), and with the Psalms and the Scripture giving light.
text.36:14: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
text.37:21: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
text.37:127: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
text.38:12: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
text.38:14: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
text.39:25: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not.
text.39:32: And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell?
text.39:59: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers.
text.40:5: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment.
text.40:70: Those who deny the Scripture and that wherewith We send Our messengers. But they will come to know,
text.50:5: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
text.50:12: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
text.50:14: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
text.52:14: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
text.54:3: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
text.54:9: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
text.54:18: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
text.54:33: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
text.54:42: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

text.57:19: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
text.62:5: The likeness of those who are entrusted with the Law of Moses, yet apply it not, is as the likeness of the ass carrying books. Wretched is the likeness of folk who deny the revelations of Allah. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.
text.64:10: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end!
text.67:9: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.
text.67:18: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!
text.68:44: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
text.69:4: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
